reviews.title: Winter wonderland!!
reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a luxurious getaway in Gulmarg, The Khyber Resort is the place to be. Nestled amidst stunning snow-capped peaks, this resort offers a truly picturesque experience. The views alone are worth it—imagine waking up to a blanket of white, with pristine mountains stretching as far as the eye can see. And It’s just 100 meters from the Gulmarg Gondola. 

The hospitality here deserves a special mention. Bilal and Nazima went above and beyond to make our stay memorable.

Food at The Khyber is excellent! The Lebanese restaurant is a standout—not only does it serve authentic cuisine, but the addition of sheesha makes it an even more enjoyable experience. Don’t miss Brava, where I highly recommend trying their Spaghetti Arrabbiata—it’s absolutely delicious. Also, all restaurants here are BYOB for in-house guests which was a surprise for us. 

If you’re planning to visit, make sure to go during the snow season. The magic of The Khyber in winter is unmatched, with its cozy interiors and breathtaking surroundings.

Everything we ate was disappointing except for some daal and rice at dinner once -- the Italian restaurant is something people should avoid. There are many illogical decisions with decor (too dark) and music (terrible). Many of the Indian guests are extremely rude and bad mannered and it ruins your experience to see them treating servers that way. In general, although I was delighted to visit Khyber after having heard so much about it, it was definitely not worth the outrageously exorbitant price (most I've ever paid for a hotel in my life!). The only consolation is I hope this money goes to support the economy of Kashmir at this time. Two of the female staff (Nusrat at reception; Hameeda at the pool downstairs) went out of their way for us and made us feel really comfortable.

reviews.title: Average hospitality with lacking infrastructure but really good food.
reviews.text:
For the longest time, Gulmarg meant Khyber to me. We visited the resort on 17th March with an intention of staying within the property only for the full day. We were 4 couples with 2 children. 

So we checked in on 17th March at around 3.30 PM. The usual check-in is at 2 PM. We were informed that 1 of the rooms is still not ready. Not sure why as we were already checking in 90 mins later than usual. The checkin process at their end is super clumsy and took about 45 mins in total. Not sure why.

Since we had arrived after traveling for 5 hours, we were hungry and none of their restaurants were ready to serve us. The only place where the food was available was their cafe- Chaikash which honestly is supremely understaffed. Hence the basic sandwich and pizza took about an hour.

Coming to the rooms, we were on the 5th floor. They have an issue with the plumbing and hence the bathrooms were smelling. In one of the rooms suddenly at 4 AM, AC started making weird noises and hence it had to be switched off. When complained to the management team about it with video proof, they offered an extended stay till  evening. We declined since we already had activities planned after the check out. 

Food is really good.

If honestly asked, I wouldn't recommend the property to anyone. With the amount that they charge they really lack the warmth in the hospitality and infrastructural amenities.

We stayed at Taj in Srinagar and everyone could feel the difference in the hospitality.

reviews.author: P_1015
reviews.title: Terrible experience, avoid at all costs!
reviews.text:
We had a really bad experience at The Khyber Resort. We paid an enormous amount and were treated so badly.

When we arrived at the hotel, there was a literary festival in progress. The hotel staff and the management were clearly differentiating between the VIP festival guests and ordinary guests like us - this poor experience continued throughout the day where we were just not treated well. 

The hotel guests were not wearing masks, and the hotel staff was not insisting on it. No COVID protocol was being followed because the entire lobby was packed with VIP Security and staff. 

The hotel did not inform us that of the 4 restaurants onsite, only one was available for the ‘non-festival’ guests. Absolutely no information was provided about this along with the booking. 

Further, though the pool is closed due to covid, the hotels Instagram account continuously advertises their pool facilities, misleading guests. And while they claim that this is due to COVID, no other COVID protocol is being followed here. Gym and spa are fully open - how is this safe? 

When we checked in, there were dirty dishes outside our room, which were only removed after three hours and that too when we called housekeeping. This is an appalling experience for guests. No one wants to see dirty dishes outside their room upon checkin! The staff were clearly not interested in anybody who wasn’t part of the VIP entourage. 

When we reached out to the hotel manager, he was dismissive rather than addressing our concerns. His response was - you should’ve told me sooner. Another manager called us on the phone and told us that he can’t do anything either. 

This is a terrible experience, there’s simply no point in staying in this hotel. They’re looting their guests. Good luck to you if you’re an ordinary guest and not a VIP.

reviews.author: Vaishali Joshi
reviews.title: Holiday in Paradise
reviews.text:
Four couples from Goa, including us, decided to take a trip to Gulmarg  after what has been a truly turbulent year for humanity. 
We were there in early April and serendipitously we were greeted by heavy snowfall.  Usually,  the snow starts to melt by April. This put us in a perfect vacay mood and we looked forward to a 'Chilled out' holiday! 
From the moment you enter the Resort,  you're transported into a different world.  The tastefully, exotic interiors put you in a wonderful mood . The view is just too fabulous from the resort. The Mighty Himalayas,  the Gulmarg valley and the Pine trees weave a magical atmosphere! 
We were in a Gulmarg facing room and I personally loved it.  Much ado is made about the Himalaya facing room , however the view from everywhere in the hotel is magnificent. 
They don't serve Alcohol but you can carry your own and sit in the Sheesha lounge in the evening and enjoy yourself. 
The food is quite nice , not excellent,  but the servers are always ready to please.  Firdaus, Feroze and Shaukat really took good care of us and made us very comfortable and welcome. 
The Mini Wazwan or Trami is like a Kashmiri Thali and has some Kashmiri specialities.  However,  I suggest you have this in Srinagar.  
The best thing about the resort was the Indoor heated pool overlooking the snowcapped mountains.  It was a surreal experience . 
The Gondola , ATV rides are all walking distance from the resort and you can really have the time of your life!

reviews.author: Ambar
reviews.title: Absolutely fabulous! Insanely brilliant service and the slopes and snow are so good!
reviews.text:
I stayed here for 7 nights from 02Feb to 09Feb. We were 2 people, who came to snowboard. 

Airport pickup: we had asked the hotel for an airport pick and drop. This was very smooth. There was a guy right at the baggage belt, with our names on a placard and he took us out to the car, in the parking lot. The car driver was nice and friendly and we stopped in the way for a quick bite. 

Check in: Was smooth. We sat in the lounge while it was done. A bit weird, but I was asked for the invoice for the booking, which I clearly didn’t have (who does). Anycase, that wasn’t a hindrance. Checkin went smooth. 

Rooms: there are rooms with our without balcony. We took one with a balcony. Ideally, in winters, avoid a balcony room. Also, the balcony rooms come with Gulmarg view and mountain view - the mountain view is gorgeous! (Perhaps for summer). 

Restaurant: the restaurant was good and the quality of food and the service was quite nice. There is a variety of food. We did the dinner buffet one night, which was a bit disappointing - 6/10, I’d say. Breakfast was very well laid and great quality. 

Bar : the hotel doesn’t serve/sell alcohol but you’re welcome to bring your own booze and sit in the sisha lounge and drink. This worked out quite comfortably. There is service there and you get everything you need. A SHOUTOUT to Firdous, at the Shisha lounge. His service was exemplary. Made us feel welcome and service was very personalised. 

Ski/snowboard: the gondola is about a 400m walk from the hotel but it’s a steep climb back to the hotel. Unlike all good ski resorts, here there is no shuttle service. I asked the management and was told that the local taxi drivers don’t allow hotel cars (to maintain their monopoly). The local taxi guys charge 500rupees for this 500m trip. 
Possibly the only downside. 

Gondola : beautiful. Well maintained. 

Hotel pool and gym : 
The gym is very good, well equipped and quite scenic. 
The pool is very scenic, but for winter months, I think it’s a bit cold. I was hoping it to be like an onsen (like in Japan) or a hottub(in the states/Europe), but its much cooler which made me refrain from going into it. 

Internet: the internet of the hotel is quite good, considering how remote the hotel is. 

All in all - 9/10 (possible because of shuttle service). 

Will come back.

reviews.title: Solid property with service flaws

The spa, pool and gym area is generous although it can get noisy in the late afternoon. Breakfast and dinner is served buffet style. Food quality and variety is quite satisfying. It could be a 4 star property if the service would match. Staff at reception is polite but if you need something from them you probably have to ask twice or thrice. Housekeeping is also lacking. I wasn't able to get more than 2 small towels throughout our stay despite numerous reminders. Nevertheless, I would likely return to the Khyber as other hotels do not have the same infrastructure.

Ensured wifi was working ( very important to city girls ). He even called us to alert us to look out our room windows as it began to snow!! Much appreciated and amused! Mr Hamid was always nearby to say hello with his broadest smile. Always eager to help with anything. A service standard with an edge above all.

We would like to thank F&B manager who ensured we ate well. He was quick and flexible with our difficult requests, another service standard many other hotels need to learn from.

Overall, we felt so treasured and important in Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, like how a fully mesmerised guest should feel. Keep up the wonderful job. Definitely recommending this! 

We will miss you
Jillis

reviews.title: Perfect, Almost
reviews.text:
Arrival was very welcoming, the staff are terrific. The location is amidst snow-covered mountains and pine trees, beautiful views all around, one couldn't do better with the location. The gondola ride is a 5 minute walk down the road, but if you are older or not used to walking in the snow, then get a ride. The restaurant offers excellent food choices, although a bit expensive. 

Couple points, we had a room with twin beds, this typically means two separate beds, but here the beds are joined, we had to ask them to separate these beds, yet I could hear my freind snore. My friend left his boots in the cloak room, and a hotel guest took his boots, the staff traced the guest, sent a couple staff members and got the boots back. Every time they erred, they fixed it, every single time.

That said, to be honest and fair, I would say they are a good solid 4 star hotel, compared to places such as The Monasterio in Lima, Peru. Even a 4.5, but don't let that take away anything from this beautiful, well managed, friendly place. Highly recommended.

The First&B manager went out of his way to ensure the stay and meals were very comfortable. I had a severe tooth ache and in the middle of the night the doctor on call literally made it within 20 minutes to give me the right treatment and injection. The pain that I felt this was inparallled and all thanks to the doctor the trip was such a fantastic experience the next few days. The rooms, view, hospitality and gulmarg itself is brilliant. 

For honeymoons, family trips I think anyone in India who hasn't been there yet is a fool for missing out on this treasure. 

We plan to go there this year too in February and hopefully every year after. 

Take a bow, team Khyber. You make us proud.

reviews.title: "Khyber" Best Hospitality in The Himalayas
reviews.text:
I am an Airline Pilot and travel all around and I will say my Favorite place to stay is Khyber in Gulmarg because of the warm hospitality, friendly and loving team which is carefully selected by a experienced management who working together as a team makes Khyber the best hotel I will say.

I have visited and stayed in Khyber for over 60 days while I enjoy Gulmarg in its full beauty during Jan, Feb and march with snow all around. 
2015,2016 & 2017 stay has been outstanding and memorable.

It's a "SNOW PARADISE" with over 20 feet of snow recorded every winter and the quality of snow and ski terrain is simply magical.
I have skied in New Zealand , Europe and Australia and so far I must say Gulmarg is the best.

Stay at Khyber is extremely comfortable with centrally heated airCon and a heated pool with Amazing Breathtaking Views, it's a Superior Luxury resort with the highest ratings and facilities.

Khyber has one of the best views of The ski Terrain which is over 4000m and the beautiful Peaks all around.It is conveniently located near Gondola.

The warmth can be felt upon arrival in Srinagar until flying back making it one of the most memorable trips of your life just because of the excellent hospitable staff and the beautiful property nestled in the mountains. I feel blessed to to say that we have such a luxury ski resort making Gulmarg a world class destination.

In fact I have seen hotel guests booking for the next year while checking out, it's simply an amazing and an unforgettable experience. 
Words are not enough to describe the beautiful memories I have and one can experience staying in Gulmarg at Khyber.
I always think very highly of the staff and management which does it job so diligently making it the best hotel by a good margin.

Can't wait to be back in Khyber.

RESERVATIONS:
Our reservation was nicely handled by Mr Irshad and Wahid and all our needs were conveyed to concerned departments before our arrival.
RECEPTION:
Check in was smooth and welcome drink Kashmiri kahwa was excellent. They upgraded us to gulmarg view balcony room for nominal amount and Mr Manzoor escorted us to room and made sure that everything was as per our requirements. Luggage arrived in few minutes only. Special thanks to Mr Manzoor and his team members Parvez, Saquib, Ishfaq for making sure that our stay was comfortable and conveyed warm greetings whenever we passed through reception area.

HOUSEKEEPING:
Excellent thanks to Mr Abhishek and his team.

SWIMMING POOL/SPA:
It is highlight of khyber with best view you can ever get from any pool in world.

RESTAURANT:
Food & beverage and service at restaurant was major highlight of our stay thanks to Mr Bashrat and Mr Abid and his entire team - Sameer, Bilal, Showket Wani, Qadir, Ishfaq, Junaid, Showket Khan, Erfan and Saila. Exec chef Sharma and his team made sure that all our special needs and dietary requirements were met to perfection.

Except for wifi which is super slow and problem with water cleaning at swimming pool, our stay was most memorable thanks to warm and efficient service and attention by entire Khyber team. 

Will surely return back next winter.  Hope you keep up the spirit and continue to strive to improve as you have between our last 2 visits.

reviews.author: hakothari
reviews.title: Most pathetic 5 star property ever witnessed, deserves to be called one star property
reviews.text:
We booked 3 premier rooms through agent(Dastan Travels) for check in on 29th June 16 and check out on 30th June 16 (3 couples and one infant). I would like to take all the readers through disaster experience at so called 5 star property Khyber so that you will think twice before emptying your pockets for their pathetic services.

We were highly disappointed to know on 28th june evening that we will not be able to use heated pool(highlight of the property) as the same has undergone maintenance w.e.f 29th June till 10th July. To be noted they did not give any prior intimation to agent/ us about the same and we got to know through their website.

Check in experience was even worse than a 1 star property. We reached hotel lobby at 11.45 am and infant traveling with us was quite unwell and restless because of health issue.They assured us of best rooms asap. At 2.30 pm after almost all the guests got their check in done, they took us to the left over rooms which they allotted to us(room no. 5011, 5012, 5014). To our surprise, they allotted room with twin size beds to 2 couples and when we objected, they simply said they did not realise it and apologised. 
Next they gave us room 4001, 4003 and 4006. Room 4001 and 4003 had car parking of the hotel as room view. We had no choice as all other rooms were given to their preferred customers. We were utterly depressed to realise we have paid approx INR 20,000 for such a room. Obviously there was zero privacy level and trespassers could easily peep in the room so you cannot pull off the curtains at any point of time. Room 4006 had no view at all and all one could see was hotel property and adjacent cottages so we denied taking that room. 

They again shifted 3rd couple back to room 5011 and said this is all we can give you so we compromised with a room view of iron wires and wooden rods and cursed ourselves to waste INR 20,000 on such a property. There was only a slight glimpse of Himalayas which is the USP of the khyber property. By the time we got settled, it was 3.30 pm(took more than 3 hrs just to check in) and lunch time was over for us so we dint had lunch because of all the hassles faced.
Finally at 6 pm we could have first meal of the day and it seemed really delicious as we all were hungry to the core.
We had a one to one meeting with Mr. Vineet Chhabra(Hotel manager in charge) and explained him about each and everything we faced. He just nodded to us and accepted everything and kept apologising. He offered us complementary dinner and assured us that we will not face any further trouble. Dinner experience was good enough and food was the only good thing about Khyber.
Next day we checked out at 11.30 and asked them to keep our luggage in cloak room as we were proceeding to Gondola. When we came back to take our luggage, we were shocked and taken aback to see the way our luggage was literally thrown out of the hotel and they justified they have no empty space in cloak room. They placed a 20 kg suitcase over my hat and another 15kg bag over eatables.In addition we also experienced below mentioned issues:
 - Since the rooms had no AC, because of suffocation, we ultimately had to ask hotel guys to put a fan in our room at night 1.30 am
 - There was water leakage in room 4003. 
 - Phone provided in room 5011 was not working and had to be repaired.
 - Whenever any housekeeping/ cleaning/any other assistance was required, it was not a very prompt one, it took atleast 20 mins for someone to come and do the needful may be because rooms are very widely spread across the property.
 - There was absolutely no co ordination among the people representing the hotel.

So all in all it was a total money waste for us and we had the worst stay ever at any 5 star property. Not at all recommended.Pathetic service and below average room views.

If inspite of all the above issues, one still wishes to stay at Khyber, do so at your own risk as hotel guys are not trained to make your stay memorable.

reviews.title: Beautiful beyond words!
reviews.text:

The rooms were huge, the balconies had the view of the valley and the hills on either side. We were particularly lucky to have experienced both, a sunny day and the snowfall. The view changed dramatically from bright lush green pines to snow clad trees and frozen in time sights over our stay of 4 days. 
The service staff in the restaurant lacked training and weren't attentive at all but it hardly mattered as everything else more than made up for it. 
The hotel is spread over a large area and is beautifully made with wood and glass. The spa and pool is an exceptional experience. It was definitely the different views from the hotel that made it so special. 
Gulmarg (Kashmir), is certainly heaven as rightly said by the Persian poet, Amir Khusro, 'If there is paradise on the face of earth, It is this, it is this, it is this!' 
"Agar firdaus bar roo-e zameen ast, Hameen ast-o hameen ast-o hameen ast"

reviews.title: Haven in the mountains
reviews.text:
Nestled in the deep woods , the Khyber is located at the foot hills of the snow clad mountains . It gives you the illusion of actually being in the midst of snow and the perfect central heating allows you the best of both worlds- the comfort of waking up to the snow enveloped in the warmth of your room. 

The majestic entrance has kept the Kashmiri architecture in mind and the extensive use of wood adds a warm glow to the property. 
The rooms are spacious nd the balconies offer outstanding views . The sunk in bath tub overlooking the woods is the highlight of the room . 

The restaurant has a decent buffet , but the Wazwan was not upto the mark . The tabak Maas was dry and rubbery , the gravies were too thick and oily . The Haaq saag was excellent though . For us , the best was the trout which we ordered for starters . 
The kids had white sauce pasta which was excellent . The hotel does not serve alcohol , though they do allow you to have your own in the Hooka bar /-without corkage charges. 
The service was good 

It is located close to the  Gondolas .

reviews.author: Vivek G
reviews.title: Truly, the best property in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
If you are traveling to Gulmarg and you want to stay in the best resort there, think no further. Our group of 12 (incl 6 kids) stayed at Khyber for two nights early January. The resort is right in the middle of Himalayas and in a picture perfect location. You can take those Kodak picture moments from any point in the resort. The interiors and exteriors are just splendid. The resort has a nice restaurant (clove), a coffee shop, a cigar lounge and a spa.

We picked the regular deluxe room with extra bed in each room. Kids above 5 will be charged extra. Our package included breakfast and internet. The resort is less than 500 meters from the Gondola and a 10min walking distance from the Skiing area (beginners). 

The hotel premises were spotless and professionally managed. Breakfast and Dinner buffets at Clove were pretty good. The main course of the dinner buffet needs to be updated. I enjoyed the continental appetizers and hors d'oeuvres. Very little choices for non-vegetarian items in the main course. The hotel does not have a liquor license and it was disappointing.

The cigar lounge is an interesting set up. You can smoke Cigars and Hookah but not cigarettes. You can bring your own liquor and the hotel will serve the rest of the stuff (snacks, sodas etc.) We enjoyed our time there. 

Some tips for fellow travelers:
- It costs Rs. 300 to go from the hotel to the ski area or the Gondola (one way). And Hotel will not be able to arrange this for you. We were told that the cab services in Gulmarg are controlled by a small group. We struggled quite a bit to get a car when needed. There are couple of guys hanging out in the arrival area. They will not only try to get you a car but also try to sell you a general guide, tickets to gondola, tickets to ski slope, guide to ski slope etc.
- And if you do not go with those additional services, you will not get your cab when you need it. This is border line blackmail. I hated this so much that we walked the 10min when we could. It is much harder to walk back to the Resort because of the steep incline of the road.
- Best option is to make a deal with the car that drove you to the hotel from Tangmarg.
- You will also be pressured by many people to hire a guide. We had at least 20 people that approached us during the 10 min walk from resort to Gondola. They asked anywhere from Rs.600 - Rs.2000. They will tell you many stories and try to scare you as well. We did not take a guide.I suggest that you pick one (can negotiate for Rs. 300) for two reasons. One is that you will not be approached by anyone else. The second reason is that the guide can discretely talk to the security guys in phase 1 of Gondola and extend the time you can spend there by a few house.
- Buying tickets for the Gondola is quite easy. Once you are in the phase 1 area, you are required to return in one hour. 
- The published rates for snow mobile rides in Gondola are also exaggerated. We negotiated ride to PK1 for Rs.1000/person (published rate was Rs. 2000)
- If you are looking for a guide + ski equipment, you will have to negotiate quite a bit as well. We were quoted anywhere from 2000 to 4000/ person for this. We did not make a decision until we reached the ski area. There we were able to negotiate a guide + ski equipment + lessons + skiing for 3 hours for Rs. 1000/person. That also included a cab ride back to the resort.

reviews.author: Indore Rocks
reviews.title: Jammu & Kashmir's heavenly beauty is only complemented by this great resort !
reviews.text:
It is really a great Small Luxury Hotel - how resorts are meant to be ! Definitely the best in Gulmarg or rather in whole of Jammu & Kashmir ! 

The resort is marvellous with its decor, ambience, location, and people. Location is the best bit. We travelled in a large group of Young Indians (Yi) - around 80 of us (yeah) !!! And had the resort to us. 

The rooms & suites were brilliant - each overlooking the Himalayan mountains or the Gulmarg village, both picturesque. The balconies in the rooms were just superb. 

The staff took great care. The managers and their team members were all brilliant. especially Mr. Mallik Zaffar. 

Although the food was quite good, the vegetarian options may be improved. The Kashmiri Tea - Kahwa - is served every day and is brilliant. 

The L'Occitane Spa is wonderful, though only same-gender therapists allowed. 

The temperature-controlled indoor swimming pool overlooking the valley is superb, however, it had some mosaic tiles coming off when we went and needed some repairs. 

There are various other entertainment options, but we didn't get to try many as we had lots to do with the group. 

Our arrangements were made all the more easy & brilliant because our complete tour's booking & stay arrangements were made by J&K's best travel agency - Shiraz Travels, Srinagar. 

We had a brilliant time going on one of world's highest ropeways - the Gulmarg Gondola. And we also enjoyed teeing off at one of world's highest golf courses too - the Gulmarg Golf Club !

reviews.text:
I went to Khyber for afternoon tea. My plan was to return and stay at the hotel with my family in Dec 2015, during snow season. The infrastructure and decor of this hotel deserves a 5 star! Everything looks splendid. However, like mentioned in many of the other reviews, the behaviour of the staff really falls short of expectations. There are no clear instructions written about which areas/lounges are only for residents and what are their opening-closing timings. So we went to lounges, without being stopped by anyone (security or staff), only to be told very rudely later that we weren't suppose to do so. I understand that all hotels have their own rules, but if they don't let the guests know, how are we to guess? 

I have stayed in many hotels across different countries in the last 20 years. However, I haven't seen such discourteous staff before. If it wasn't for my friend, I don't think I would have stayed for my cup of tea (Kashmir khawa priced at INR 300 a cup). In hindsight, I shouldn't have. We were served without a smile. We paid with our credit cards, and there too the cashier was impolite. The only friendly person was the doorman at the main entrance. 

I don't think I want to come back to stay in a hotel that charges like INR 20,000 for a night, and yet treats its guests like it's doing us a favour!

My friend Raman Khosla & I were delighted to spend 2 nights from June 24-26 at this super luxurious resort. Contrary to many reviews on this site, we found the staff of this resort cordial. Both our contacts with the reception were very good, Sajjad during check in & Manzoor at check out.

The service here was very good. Sajad Lone at this restaurant was specially very warm & friendly. Though the wifi internet was paid (Rs 750 / 24 hours for 2 devices) it was fast & worth it. Special thanks to Adil at the reception & Farook from the wifi team for helping us restore our wifi internet in a few minutes even as early as 5 am. 

The warm swimming pool in the cold rainy weather felt out of this world. The spa could be more well planned. The men's area doesn't have any changing rooms, the shower rooms need more hanging facilities, the urinals could be segregated. We had very good massage & facial therapies at the L'Occitane spa (separate review).

We stayed here in 2nd week of June 2015 a group of 20 people 5 families. The best stay one can imagine. Very nice property. Excellent location. Very nice rooms. The best food you can imagine of. Very good service. Excellent House keeping. Good Dinning. Very good Menu. Very nice spa. Heated pool is an added feature. Good security. Very nice view.

A few drawbacks : Charging 7 star property rates but no plants, no greenery inside hotel. A few plastic pots are placed but plants in bad position. Spread in 8 acres but no flowers. Parking system very bad. Our taxis were not allowed to stay in parking. So for 2 days we were without vehicle. The location of hotel is on a hill. reviews.author: Gotta Travel
reviews.title: A destination in its own right
reviews.text:
There are those people who come to Gulmarg & then there are those who come to the Khyber. The Khyber has truly become a destination in its own right. Gulmarg was crying out for a property like this - top end rooms, very high end villas, good food & a great spa. 

The rooms are large, well appointed & comfortable. All the mod-cons are at your finger tips - temperature control, in room coffee/tea making making facilities, satellite TV, wifi (with slightly iffy speed & signal strength). The bathrooms are nice with a separate shower stall & a tub by the window. The tubs are perfect for a romantic soak as you watch the moon rise over the mountains. 

Room tip - ask for a room facing the spa because it's a better view though the rooms on the other side aren't shabby either. 

The hotel offers a multi cuisine restaurant, with both a buffet & a menu to choose from. The breakfast is a star meal with a live egg station and fabulous South Indian dosa-idli breakfasts. There is a tea lounge with a wide range of teas & coffees. If you are trying to kick the caffeine habit try the rose tea, it's amazing. 

A hookah or sheesha lounge is available tans is a nice place to spend the evening chatting & reliving the days experiences. 

Point to note - the hotel doesn't sell alcohol but will be happy to serve you your own if you bring it with you. 

The spa is a revelation with a lovely heated pool. Heaven is watching the snow come down as you lounge around in the pool. There is a gym with some basic free weights, a multi gym and some cardio equipment. I haven't tried the treatment rooms but it's a La Occitane spa so it must be great. 

So whether it's a honeymoon, a family holiday or a skiing trip this is a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: Didn't know what to expect coming to Gulmarg.  Our Heli-Skiing operation gave us the option to stay at a few different places around Gulmarg and we chose Khyber because one of our group wasnt snowboarding... very happy that we made that choice.  Hotel staff is very friendly and willing to help but sometimes it was difficult to understand what they were saying (nit-picking but thats why 4 stars, not 5).  However, they were always eager to help.  The facility is very nice and comfortable... rooms, restaurant (food pretty good and lots of options) spa.  Would definitely come back to stay at The Khyber if/when I come back to Gulmarg.  Also, its just next to the gondola so getting up and down from the mountain so if youre planning to ski/snowboard, its a great location

reviews.author: Sanasawhney19
reviews.title: Hospitality at it's finest
reviews.text:
Stayed at The Khyber for 3 nights and I must say this hotel is worth every penny spent. 

Bedroom was cozy and comfortable with a spectacular view of the resort.
The most important aspect of any room in a hotel is the bathroom, and full marks to the hotel on that front.

The best part about Khyber was the hospitality, right from the driver who picked us up at the Srinagar airport to the bell boy who helped us while checking out were amazing. 
We even used the services of the resident physician Dr.Nazir a couple of times, really appreciate the way he took care of us and called in from time to time to check on our health.
Special mention for Mr.Shyam, Mr.Samir and their team at Cloves and Calabash. What an incredibly enthusiastic, hard working group they are. Some of the guys from the team deserve special recognition.
1) Arshid
2) Ishfaq
3) Yasir 
4) Bilal
These guys along with their managers made this perfect holiday an unforgettable one. These guys definitely are a great asset to the hotel.

Definitely going to recommend it to anyone traveling to Gulmarg. Kudos to the entire team at Khyber.

reviews.author: Shruti1911
reviews.title: Sensational Khyber
reviews.text:
We stayed for 3 nights at Khyber and it is truly magical. The service is one of the best we have come across. The rooms are lovely. The location superb. the views from the hotel and rooms is spectacular. While Gulmarg in the winters is anyways one of the most beautiful places on earth, what made our trip special was the staff at the hotel. Not one in particular but across, everyone was so helpful and the hospitality is at a different level. I would like to name a few who made our trip even more special:
Arshid - he was so helpful, took our pictures, helped us in the deep snow and always courteous.
Mr. Shyam - he was managing the restaurant and took our preferences so he could include in the buffet menu the next day. Amazing.
Others who I would also like to mention are Bilal, Ajaj, Ishfaq, Samir and Yasir. I am sure I have forgotten many more who were as good.

reviews.author: Dip0
reviews.title: Magical Place
reviews.text:
The Khyber at Gulmarg is simply a fairy tale - beautiful and magical. We stayed for 3 nights and what made this trip really special is the hospitality of the staff at khyber. They made us feel so special and i just have to mention a few names who made this trip magical.
1. Arshid - extremely helpful and was patient and wonderful and took great photos
2. Manager Shyam who ensured that we always got great food
In addition also wanted to mention Ishfaq, Samil and Bilal

The rooms are a great size with an enormous bed. 
Just 2 suggestion:
orientation of the hotel when we check in - we were a little lost and took us a a bit to find the lobby
change plug points in the hotel as even the mechanics struggle with them

Overall a magical property

reviews.author: Thenny M
reviews.title: Serene space
reviews.text:
The property although is huge, it gives a homely feeling, staff is super friendly, always willing to help with a smile. The space is gorgeous, especially the room overlooking the Himalayas, is just breathtaking.  The spa and the indoor heated pool are located in a perfect space to get rid of sore muscle after a day of skiing.  
The cottages are great for group with its own private seating/dining area.
I wish I had more time to enjoy all the facilities, had a fantastic time, highly recommend it.

reviews.author: PKT207
reviews.title: The hidden Jewel of India in Paradise
reviews.text:
So, let me start by saying that I was surprised with everything I saw from the moment I entered Gulmarg. It was blissful. It has snowed for 3-4 days and the entire landscape was filled with lush white powder. 

And, when we entered Khyber, it was a world apart. I was taken aback by the ideal location, the beautiful resort, impeccable service, and amazing food. 

The resort itself is mystical with great views. Our room had a great balcony overlooking the mountains. We were very happy with our rooms. the common areas were also great. It has a beautiful spa and gym. However, the heated pool stands out in the cold weather. 

Since all our meals were in the hotel itself, I really enjoyed everything. Though, I do think they can work on their Kashmiri taste a little bit. 

The service was amazing. From the bell boy to the reception to housekeeping, they were very well trained and friendly. They did everything we asked for and took really good care of us. 

I had injured my foot, so their in-house doctor was very helpful in sorting our my injury. 

I fell in love with the place and hope to visit it over and over again.

reviews.author: TheJMs
reviews.title: Great hotel and location
reviews.text:
We were there for four days skiing. Location is ideal for the lift station just round the corner and easy to get a lift if don't want the short walk.

Hotel of the highest standard with staff who appear genuinely friendly rather than having been trained to be so.

Spa facilities very good. Exceptionally good value for both accommodation and food. 

Clearly there are safety concerns but we felt comfortable during our visit and the locals were more than welcoming. 

Only tip is take your own alcohol as the hotel has no licence but happy for you to drink in the lounge. In particular take wine as no where to buy it locally.

Overall a great stay.

reviews.author: AhujaKamal
reviews.title: Superb!!!
reviews.text: Kashmir is heaven on earth and Khyber resort the shining star in Kashmir. I was pleasantly surprised to check into this amazing property amidst beautiful settings of nature in Gulmarg. What really amazed me was top class luxury that I had neither experienced or expected in a hill station in India. Of course Wild flower hall is an exception. But we as a group of 4 families with kids had an unbelievable time. The hotel is totally comfortable for kids with a nice warm pool , game arcade and warm staff. Spa is excellent too. We took skiing lessons on slopes just about 5 mins from the resort. Would definitely come back often. While here a few times a question popped into my mind ;Switzerland ???

reviews.author: kalebjohn
reviews.title: Only a snow resort
reviews.text: Khyber gulmarg is a snow resort typically suited to skiers while we were there it did not snow and may be because of that we d not enjoy our stay. The hotel has average views infact we liked the views of Highlands park as much better. The food also is typical 5* food and heavy. We do not recommend khyber without snow.

reviews.author: Ashish Jain
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel and comfort
reviews.text: Recently stayed for 3 nights, must stay in rooms with balcony, amazing view. Very comfortable stay, good food and not to miss superb SPA, Jacuzzi and hot water pool. Especially if you are in winter time during snow season a must stay hotel.

reviews.author: Nikhilraj1968
reviews.title: The Khyber
reviews.text:
This was our second time at the Khyber and it was brilliant. The GM and the staff left no stone un-turned to ensure that we had the best vacation possible. The service at the Khyber is very good with every staff well trained and mannered. So the atmosphere is always very positive.

The heated pool is one of the best feature of the hotel. A fully equipped gym with steam, sauna and jacuzzi and a top class spa helps take away the aches form the skiing and trekking. Good food at the restaurants kept us well fed.

The hotel is very close to the gondola to ride to the ski slopes and also close to the bunny slope for beginners.

Excellent value.

reviews.author: SamayGambhir
reviews.title: Amazing holiday
reviews.text: I feel that it was the best hotel in the area. The staff are extremely polite, helpful and efficient. the views of the balcony and nouf are amazing. The rooms at the hotel were amazing. There were good bathrooms in the room. Every room had a heating system.   The location is amazing for a person visiting for an outdoor activity. It is a minute away from the gondola cable car service and 5 minutes away from the golf course/ beginner slopes in ski season. The design of the room was very thoughtful. The highlight of the hotel was the pool and spa complex. They have a heated pool and separate jacuzzis, saunas and steam baths for men and women. Just sitting in the jacuzzi after 5 hours of skiing was very relaxing. The view from the swimming pool is amazing. you feel the warmth of the pool while looking at the snow capped himalayas. I however did not use the spa. The hospitality provided by the hotel was great. The only downside was that the facilities at the igloo (gaming area) were not so good. They had only two games for the xbox and used all sorts of equipment for different games. They have a really good restaurant. the kashmiri kahwa is a must try. special meantion to the staff Ishfaq(restaurant), Sajad Ahmed Lone(restaurant and Gulzar(housekeeping). Overall it was an amazing holiday.

reviews.author: Dutchie_in_Delhi
reviews.title: At this price point, should do better!
reviews.text:
We went to the Khyber to spend Christmas on the roof of the world.
Although our overall experience was pleasant, the mountains beautiful, the hotel nicely decorated and the company splendid (3 best friends!), there were some disappointments which at this price point are nearly unacceptable.
Kashmir is a wonderful but conflicted area, and the existence of this resort is a good sign for its development and economic growth. Being owned by a local, the love for the valley is to be seen throughout the resort, beautiful handicrafts and traditional furniture are applied with care.
The spa is gorgeous and wonderful, all three of us got a treatment there which deeply relaxed us.
Now, for the disappointments:
- tea served was Tetley.... Seriously? In India? In a luxury resort? A supermarket brand tea bag? 
- our (standard) room had view over the parking lot.
- even though we had had several email exchanges with the resort, check in was confused and staff nervous.
- only one restaurant was open. It was OK but nothing exceptional. Actually there was a second restaurant open. Specializing in grilled meats. But it served outdoors, with temperatures below zero.... Even the gas heaters couldn't make up for the cold.
- the hotel has a snooker table, but in that room you can neither eat nor drink.
- no alcohol. I understand it's Kashmir, but still.
- slow service, at breakfast we had to wait upwards of 10 minutes to get our coffee/tea
-diesel fumes from heating system wafting their way into the hotel.

So overall I would, unfortunately, not go back here.

reviews.author: ananya s
reviews.title: Heaven is a place on earth
reviews.text:
We went to Khyber Himalayan at Gulmarg for a quick getaway weekend from Bombay and what a pleasant surprise! The hotel exceeds all expectations in terms of amazing hospitality and best in luxury. It is a slightly heavy on the pocket but the expense is worth it! The staff is extremely helpful and polite. The check-in was a breeze and the Kahwa served on arrival is welcome given the freezing temperatures outside. 

One must try the L'occitane Spa at the resort, which is one of the best I have been to (better than the Bombay 5 star spas). Tip: You should book it on arrival since it tends to get booked very quickly. 

Tip: Carry your swimsuits because the Hotel has an amazing indoor heated pool which you wouldn't wanna miss. Yes, I am talking about swimming while its snowing outside. The Concierge can arrange for Gondola tickets and Skiing instructors on request. 

Even though the buffet has a good variety, I believe that the hotel can improve on food. Tip: Take your own liquor because they have not yet received a liquor permit so the hotel doesn't serve alcohol. You must definitely try the Hookah Lounge, if you take your music and small speakers, they even let you play your own music (ask other's around you of course, before you do :)), you can sit there was as long as you want and no one will ask you to leave. 

The rooms are beautifully decorated and they have thought of the smallest of things. The hotel has ornate interiors and lots of nooks and corners to sit and have a warm cup of tea while lazing around with a book and a view of the snow capped peaks. Believe it or not, they have an in-house doctor who will even attend to you in the middle of the night if you have the smallest of headaches! That's the level of hospitality these guys offer.

All in all, if you looking for luxury amidst the most beautiful surroundings, Khyber Himalayan Resort is the place to go. World class standards, superb location, warm hospitality, simply outstanding!

reviews.title: an idyllic ski resort
reviews.text:
The Khyber combines hospitality expertise and personalised service. The hotel is committed to a warm setting which is both modern and comfortable with large rooms and amenities where you can feel at home. The hotel staff are enthusiastic and attentive, on hand and at your service 24/7. Whether you stay for business of leisure, every detail of the hotel is designed for your pleasure and relaxation.
Clad in timber and slate, the hotel has restaurants, cafes, heated swimming pool and spa. In summer most guests stay and go hiking along mountain trails and in winter the fresh deep powder is a snow riders’ delight. The hotel provides a delivery and pick up service to the Gulmarg gondola which rises up the mountain in two phases to 3.950 metres above sea level.
Wonderful hospitable stay - thanks to the GM, Aditya Mata and his friendly staff. In  particular, the Team Leaders: Zaffir Malik and Manzoor Alehtar.

reviews.author: Clarabellestar_UK
reviews.title: A unexpected gem in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I've just spent 7 nights in the Khyber resort, with a group of friends celebrating a 40th.

Without doubt, the Khyber is a gem in Gulmarg.  A member of the Small Luxury Hotels group, it offers 5 star facilities and accommodation in the magnificent setting of the Gulmarg ski area.

The rooms are lovely - comfortable, well appointed and impeccably clean.  After a day on the slopes it was a joy to get home and snooze, before heading out to dinner.    The food is wonderful, both Indian and continental dishes available either a la carte or buffet style.  Most of the time we were served in the Cloves restaurant (lovely).  When the hotel was fuller, we were relocated downstairs to the banqueting hall, which was by a margin less pleasant and felt more like a large school dining hall!  However, a minor gripe.

The L'Occitane spa was an unexpected treat.  Lovely setting, good massage, good value.  Much appreciated after a hard couple of days on the slopes!  I didn't get to try the pool and jacuzzi, but the gym was well appointed and barely used (the three of us working out there were the only people to have been in for a while I think.....)

The hotel is located directly above the gondola with the hotel offering free drops from the door to the gondola every morning, plus a pick up in the evening.  Not exactly ski in, ski out, but I think the best you're going to get!  Be warned though, the weather here is extreme, and if you're not lucky then you might end up walking in and out (but then again you do get to enjoy the powder when this happens...).

A couple of minor gripes - the pre-arrival service and comms could have been smoother, with the person in charge having some difficulties in getting replies from the hotel.  Service sometimes is a bit slow (if you're ordering a coffee in the morning then be prepared for a 15 minute wait).  For some reason there are no racks on the jeeps for skis?  Finally they need more boot and ski racks in the ski room.  

However, all in all, a truly memorable stay and an amazing holiday.  Would go back in an instant.

(BTW bring your own booze!  The Khyber is dry but they have no problem if you bring your own.  And if you do fancy a night out, the Highlands Hotel has a v nice bar and restaurant!)

A nice value added service would be a ski shop and professional ski instructors like in Europe because I had a bad experience with a ski instructor.

The General Manager, Aditya was an extremely helpful manager who was on on his feet pretty much round the clock.

reviews.author: Muqadus B
reviews.title: You are missing something if you didn't stay here!
reviews.text: To say that it's the most scenic hotel in Kashmir wouldn't be an understatement. It was indeed a memorable stay at Khyber Hotels, Gulmarg. reviews.author: Rupawala
reviews.title: REAL ROYAL
reviews.text:

Courteous staff & variety of food , various programs etc are just an added feature.

reviews.author: Ravibaj
reviews.title: Haven in hills
reviews.text:
When one books a room at a hill station hotel in india?one has to take a lot of things with a pinch of salt: service, menu depth, room up keep , as it gets difficult to provide the same standards as a
City hotel! But to our absolute surprise, khyber gulmarg had everything' spot on'! The service was pleasing, the food menu? Well they had Angus beef and new Zealand lamb!!! Thier ' kahva'
( Kashmiri tea) was nit only excellent but served throughout out the day with the hotels compliments! For my wife's birthday they set up a BBQ grill with two chefs in all their livery , and 
Two stewards for just the four of us, the best pine apple pastry I have had was also here incedently! I highly recommend this property!

reviews.author: Vipul S
reviews.title: Superb Resort
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Khyber  and our stay was exceptional. The first and lasting impression of the hotel was just WOW!!
From the word go, the entire staff was extremely courteous and hospitable.
Check in was smooth.
The food was lip smacking… infact it was difficult to fathom that sitting in Gulmarg we were being served one of the finest  meals we had ever had.

A special mention to Ajaz & Manjoor from front office these boys are  helpful & efficient in every way and also the staff at the restaurant.

reviews.author: Jeevan G
reviews.title: Unparalled on all counts but one
reviews.text:
Exquisite property and "the place" to stay when in Gulmarg. Gorgeous interiors and part exteriors furnished in stunning wood (Deodar, I suppose), breathtaking view outside the balcony and an awe-inspiring vicinity that make an immortal impression. If God lies in the details, I found a bit of Him / Her in their welcome "kahawa" drink; the sumptuous food they serve takes a second place. The staff is very hospitable and friendly.

I had no complaints except for one: They don't serve wines. When there is such superlative beauty surrounding you and you want to cherish the moment with some sparkling wine, how can Khyber not serve wines? Shame. I hope someday they do which would compel the four bullets (very good) to move to five (excellent).

reviews.author: Rahul C
reviews.title: Good services of Hotel & Specially Mr. Bilal in Calabash
reviews.text:
Khyber, a good property having excellent ambience and services in Gulmarg. 
Specially Mr. Bilal in Calabash is very good person and having good communication skills.
The food is absolutely delicious specially Breakfast having good variety with hygiene.

reviews.author: Pavan G
reviews.title: Bitter sweet experience at Khyber
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Khyber Resort at Gulmarg along with four friends on the night of 29th September. The weather was perfect with just a little chill as we drove into Gulmarg. The property is strikingly beautiful to say the least and is built like a fortress cocooning you in a world of beauty, peace and tranquility.  It is unlike most properties that one typically sees at the hill stations- it is very luxurious and tastefully done. The lobby, the tea lounge, the restaurants every thing is very warm and comfortable. The food is quite nice with a fair amount of variety for the breakfast and dinner buffet. The rooms are spacious, very well appointed and comfortable. The staff is courteous and helpful.
The only problem- but that is a big one is the lack of functioning elevators at a '7 star' place which is built over multiple levels in separate blocks that are not inter connected. We were in rooms two levels below the lobby level and each floor had 3 flights of stairs. In spite of the place having a soft launch over a year ago; the lack of a spa,proper gym etc. may not matter but the absence of elevators at a place more than 8500 feet above sea level is a serious issue. In fact, it made us curtail our vacation plan by a day due to the effect of the numerous steps augmenting the high altitude effect.
We found Khyber as one of the most amazing properties at a hill station in India. The presence of functioning elevators will go a long way in elevating the guest experience further.

reviews.author: Mariya_Nagree
reviews.title: Khyber: A must place to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
You feel completely relaxed and pampered at Khyber. 
The rooms are well furnished and every detail is looked after. They all look over either the valley or snow capped mountains, both of which are breathtaking! 
The cuisines, be it, Chinese, Kashmiri, Continental or even the breakfast, were delectable! 
The staff is warm, cordial and friendly. A special thanks to the manager, Mr. Alex. His hospitality and generosity made our stay at Khyber a memorable experience!!

reviews.author: SMP1943
reviews.title: Khyber in Gulmarg
reviews.text: We were at the Khyber in Gulmarg in mid-September and found the place to be a great retreat, away from the town,  tucked away amidst hills and staffed by the most polite, efficient and friendly persons at every level. Wish the pool and the Spa were functional!

reviews.author: amitgujral1961
reviews.title: Spectacular resort!
reviews.text: I think the Khyber is a destination by itself! It is one of the most beautiful mountain resorts in India. I have never seen local artifacts presented so tastefully. The staff was by far the best trained we encountered on our visit to Kashmir. Everything from the rooms, toilets, lobbies, common areas are beautiful and have all the amenities one would require. The food was excellent and when we decided to check out early morning apprehending some disturbance en-route to Srinagar, the staff had already put in breakfast hampers in our transport...I think the Khyber will set a new bench mark for the tourism trade in the Kashmir valley!

reviews.author: Ghulam N
reviews.title: Kohinoor of Kashmir
reviews.text:
No words can describe the beauty of this place, no poets can sum it in a song, no priests can chant it in a tone, such is the beauty of this resort. Right from the moment u enter this place, you are greeted with an upright security guard. When u hit their main porch u get to c one of the biggest chandeliers i have ever seen in any part of this country. The decor is perfect to Kashmiri culture. Check in seems to be spotless with the welcome drink being a cullad(cup) of kehwa. Escorting to the room,escorting and explaining the features of the room--all this just makes it up for the 2 hour journey from Srinagar.

I stayed in the mountain facing room.What mind blowing the view is early morning, You got to be lucky to be in Kashmir and even more luckier to be in Khyber to revisit the dawn and dusk from your room balcony. 

Restaurant seems to be a personalized for every guest that walks in. Kudos to the thinking behind the scenes for making every guest feel special.

Just to sum the experience short, the staff there seems to have a smile and never say no attitude which speaks of the training imparted and am sure would match up to the international standards at any given point of time.

Just an advice--Get more of the Kashmiri Cuisine rolling in the menu.

Just waiting for the pool and spa to be operational. Planning another trip after 6 months.

reviews.author: Darvish
reviews.title: Unexpected Luxury nestled in Himalayas...
reviews.text:
Gulmarg tends to be touristy and crammed during summers but Khyber’s location ensures that you’re far and away from the madding crowds besides offering you with some of the best views of the layered mountains and the mist. This is one place that will overwhelm you with its sheer grand feel, as you seldom come across a luxurious resort of this size in the hill stations. Mostly, we expect a simple & functional lobby and basic room standards, but a few addresses like this have truly raised the bar. 

Don’t miss the traditional Kashmiri Kahwa on arrival while their staff completes the check-in formalities. It’s very intimate and comfortable lounge at the far end of the extended lobby, with large bay windows separating sunlit verandahs overlooking the hills. The rooms have the typical comforts of five-star hotel and resorts in other parts of the country, just that you would not have expected it here. The décor is creatively inspired by local Kashmiri artistic motifs. However, despite being a new hotel, some structural elements had maintenance issues like the sliding door between the wardrobe and toilet. 

We had a large spacious balcony sit out attached to our room, a perfect place to brood and admire the blissful views. With Kashmir having extended daylight in summers, you have the flexibility to optimize your hours between the balcony and bathtub as the view gets replicated from toilet as well.

We preferred taking all our meals at the resort itself. The breakfast and weekend dinner buffet spread was extensive and a-la-carte menu had some interesting local cuisine choices. Service was a need area at times, as the staff was not well-trained to be attentive or make eye contacts. They looked busy all the time without really attending to the guests. Service issue was also faced when we had to request thrice for something as simple as keeping an extra duvet in the room. 

Otherwise, the team is very knowledgeable to interact with and seemed to have background experiences with some of the leading International hotel brands. The resort management also went out of their way to arrange Gondola tickets for us, a must-do experience if you are in Gulmarg. This saved us from the frustration of getting into long queues. We were advised to come back in winters, esp. February to experience another aspect of Gulmarg. 

Khyber is a destination in itself and you’re tempted to be back here soon, hopefully, their spa would be operational soon.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT LOCATION GOOD HOTEL
reviews.text: Good new property still under construction. Staff was really good and cooperative and presentable. Food quality is really good with cleanliness in the restaurant. Rooms balconies gives a lush green views of deodar trees. Only problem we faced was the smell of new wood work polish in the lobby, our room was changed after request to manager. reviews.author: IEatLOVEPray
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Our friend's booked us at The Khyber for our two night stay at Gulmarg. Nothing could have been more pleasant. The staff were efficient and friendly and the Kahwa at check-in was yummy given the chilly weather that evening. Breath-taking views  of snow-capped mountains and pine forest from every window of the resort - just magical. Rooms were well planned and spacious and I loved the cosy bathroom and the wooden flooring.  My only gripe was that spa and gym were not yet operational - sigh! There is one small set back in that there is only one restaurant in the whole resort! Having said that, the a la carte menu has a wide offering and the Chef is very hands on and accommodating. All staff from the doorman to the servers were excellent and ever so polite. Tariq and Deepak stood out at mealtimes where they took care of all 15 of us brilliantly!!

reviews.author: sushimaru
reviews.title: 雰囲気よし、ベーカリーが美味！
reviews.text:
2月上旬に宿泊してきました。まだ、2012年の12月21日にオープンしたばかりのこのホテルは、グルマルグ一の最高級ホテルであり、施設も充実しています。正直、来る前には場所的にカシミールの地方なのであまり期待はしていなかったのですが、行ってビックリしました。

従業員のサービス、清潔さ、雰囲気、お部屋、すべてをとっても洗練されており、大都市の5つ星ホテルと設備はほとんど変わりません。ホテル内に入るとまずはカシミールの緑茶、カーワのウェルカムドリンクから始まり、ガラス張りのラウンジやレストランからは山々が見渡せます。建物はカシミールの伝統木材建築で、内装も落ち着いた感じです。セキュリティー（警備員）も沢山おり、安心です。

バスルームにはバスタブがあり、シャワーブースも別、お部屋の設備もどこの5つ星ホテルと変わりません。ここはセントラル・ヒーティングシステムがあるので、外気温が氷点下の中、お湯がふんだんに使え暖房もよく効いている事はありがたいです。

従業員の感じもよく、大抵すれ違うたびに挨拶をしてくれました。まだ新しいホテルですが、皆さんとてもがんばっている印象を受けました。

レストランで夕食と朝食を頂きましたがどれもとても上品の味で、特にパン類を含めたベーカリーは今までインド在住13年の間で食べたパン類で一番美味しいものでした！しかもこのカシミールの地方で！朝のクロワッサンと、デザートで頂いたブラウニーは本当に美味でした。

夕食は、カシミール料理を召し上がりました。カシミールは野菜や果物が美味しいので、素材のうまさを生かしている印象を受けました。カシミール料理はインドの平地の料理とは違い、あまり辛くなく、食べ易いかと思います。肉料理が多いのも特徴です。

ホテルにいるかぎり、ここがインドである事を忘れさせてくれる雰囲気でした。

短所を申し上げると、バスタブの水調整が悪く、お湯が少し出る程度で、とても使える状況ではありませんでした（その代わり、シャワーはお湯が勢いよくでて気持ちよかったです）。チェックアウトの際に文句をつけたら、マネージャーの人に「なぜもっと早く言わないんだ！」と言われ、すぐにフロントの担当者に直すように言っていました。聞いたところ、まだホテルができたばかりで、時々不具合があるらしく、プレッシャーを調整すれば出が良くなるとの事でした。どちらのしろ、すぐに行動に移した様で、次のお客に迷惑が掛からない様努力しているのかと思います。

もう一つの難点は、ホテルは山の高台に位置し、とても景色が良いのですがスキー場に出るまで急勾配の坂を上り下りしなければなりません。私達は徒歩でスキー場やゴンドラ駅まで行ったのですが、年配の方々や小さいお子様連れには少々きついかもしれないので、短い距離でも車をご利用される事をお勧めします。実際、ゴンドラ駅まではホテルから徒歩5分なのですが。

あと、ホテルのホームページにスパや屋内プールの案内がありますが、こちらができるのは2013年5月以降になるらしいです。

総合的にはとても満足のいく滞在でした。

reviews.author: TanayaSharma
reviews.title: Absolutely spectacular!
reviews.text:
I spent 3 nights this month at this newly opened property in Gulmarg and was absolutely amazed at how fantastic it is! The staff, rooms, restaurants all surpassed my expectations. The rooms are very well appointed and have all the amenities one may require. I was extremely impressed by the food - the quality of the ingredients and the availability of different cuisines sitting amidst snow clad mountains was something I never expected. Must try the shisha in the hookah lounge. Also the cheese platter, lobster, vegetarian mezze platter and chocolate chip pancakes were absolutely amazing! I cannot wait to go back and am planning a week long visit in February already.
I bumped into the owner, Mr Umar Tramboo on my visit and was able to have a chat with him - to find someone who is so passionate about the hotel just explains the level of detail and care that goes into everything they do.
Definitely a must visit for everyone who loves the mountains and enjoys luxurious living simultaneously!

reviews.author: tusharrcmn
reviews.title: Beautiful place to stay in
reviews.text:
I was one of the first few guest arrived after the launch of this property.
Its an amazing place to stay in. The property is beautiful and huge with all kinds of facitlites which a luxury hotel should have. The view from the room is breathtaking, the fixtures are nice, food - the best food that i had during my four days stay in srinagar and gulmarg. We got such a warm welcome from the hotel staff. I was impressed with thier tea, coffee area and the shisha (hookah) bar. I wish a lot of success to everybody who are associated with this resort and would like to revisit for a longer duration.

reviews.author: Sujit B
reviews.title: Landmark property in Kashmir
reviews.text:
I was the first guest to check-in when the hotel opened and I half expected everything to fall apart as most hotels do on the day of opening. I was pleasantly surprised to find that despite all odds (they were snowed in) - they had their act together. The best parts first: It is built on traditional Kashmiri style - lots of wood and more wood; local carpets and decor. Brownie point for keeping the tradition alive. They had more than 80% locals as their staff; again a brownie point for giving an opportunity to the local youth. They had still not been fully trained and they bumbled around a bit and this is exactly what was endearing - genuine people in a hotel not acting like hoteliers! Food was very good; the rooms was excellent and the view was to die for.

Here are few thing that they need to watch out for: 1. Remove art pieces from the lobby - they make it look like a local shop. 2. Add more lights in the lobby. Ensure staff wearing clean dress and shoes AND clean socks that don't smell. Remove the small carpets placed under the table in the room - they can trip and cause someone serious harm (they slip on the polished floor). 3. Keep people to constantly clean the wooden stairs. Inspect each rooms for small flaws (the shower plate in my rooms was skewed).

But go - stay there even if for one night (they are priced steep) and you wont regret it!
